title: Calendar from analog clock being different than from digital clock
line: The Analog Clock's calendar popup now looks like the Digital Clock's, with pin and configure buttons in a coloured header.
explanation: The Analog Clock used a bare PlasmaCalendar.MonthView as its popup, so it got the generic calendar header: month title with < Today > beside it, no PlasmoidHeading background, no separator and no pin or configure buttons. The Digital Clock wraps the same MonthView in a Representation and turns on its showDigitalClockHeader mode, which already contains all of that. The change wraps the Analog Clock's MonthView the same way, enables that header with the applet as digitalClock, and adds a hidden pin config entry plus hideOnWindowDeactivate so the pin button works.

commits.message:
applets/analogclock: use the digital clock's calendar header

The popup showed a bare calendar with its own header, so unlike the
Digital Clock it had no pin or configure button, no header background
and a different navigation layout. Use the same header and colours.

BUG: 504930

patches.diff:
From fcd9244cf263dcffdf0510d28a761a17ddb4d432 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 10:30:17 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/analogclock: use the digital clock's calendar header

The popup showed a bare calendar with its own header, so unlike the
Digital Clock it had no pin or configure button, no header background
and a different navigation layout. Use the same header and colours.

BUG: 504930
---
 applets/analog-clock/main.xml     |  4 ++++
 applets/analog-clock/qml/main.qml | 28 +++++++++++++++++++++++++---
 2 files changed, 29 insertions(+), 3 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/analog-clock/main.xml b/applets/analog-clock/main.xml
index 07be98ee39..6fea03fa11 100644
--- a/applets/analog-clock/main.xml
+++ b/applets/analog-clock/main.xml
@@ -12,6 +12,10 @@
     <entry name="showTimezoneString" type="Bool">
       <default>false</default>
     </entry>
+    <entry name="pin" type="Bool">
+      <label>Whether the popup should remain open when another window is activated</label>
+      <default>false</default>
+    </entry>
   </group>
 
 </kcfg>
diff --git a/applets/analog-clock/qml/main.qml b/applets/analog-clock/qml/main.qml
index 9e0092d478..171ad8a975 100644
--- a/applets/analog-clock/qml/main.qml
+++ b/applets/analog-clock/qml/main.qml
@@ -14,6 +14,7 @@ import org.kde.plasma.plasmoid
 import org.kde.plasma.core as PlasmaCore
 import org.kde.ksvg as KSvg
 import org.kde.plasma.components as PlasmaComponents
+import org.kde.plasma.extras as PlasmaExtras
 import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
 
 import org.kde.plasma.clock
@@ -36,6 +37,7 @@ PlasmoidItem {
 
     Plasmoid.backgroundHints: PlasmaCore.Types.NoBackground
     preferredRepresentation: compactRepresentation
+    hideOnWindowDeactivate: !Plasmoid.configuration.pin
 
     toolTipMainText: {
         const day = Qt.locale().toString(clockSource.dateTime, "dddd");
@@ -222,14 +224,34 @@ PlasmoidItem {
         }
     }
 
-    fullRepresentation: PlasmaCalendar.MonthView {
+    fullRepresentation: PlasmaExtras.Representation {
         Layout.minimumWidth: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 22
         Layout.maximumWidth: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 80
-        Layout.minimumHeight: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 22
+        Layout.minimumHeight: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 25
         Layout.maximumHeight: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 40
 
         readonly property var appletInterface: analogclock
 
-        today: clockSource.dateTime
+        Kirigami.Theme.colorSet: Kirigami.Theme.Window
+        Kirigami.Theme.inherit: false
+
+        collapseMarginsHint: true
+        header: Item {}
+
+        PlasmaCalendar.MonthView {
+            anchors {
+                fill: parent
+                leftMargin: Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
+                rightMargin: Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
+                bottomMargin: Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
+            }
+
+            borderOpacity: 0.25
+
+            today: clockSource.dateTime
+
+            showDigitalClockHeader: true
+            digitalClock: Plasmoid
+        }
     }
 }
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Before (sweep tester, master): Analog Clock popup (left) vs Digital Clock popup (right)
After: Analog Clock popup (left) vs Digital Clock popup (right), same header, buttons and layout

review.text: Reuses the existing showDigitalClockHeader mode of the shared MonthView exactly as the Digital Clock does, adding only the pin config entry and hideOnWindowDeactivate that the header needs. The after screenshot shows both popups matching. Fuzzy and Binary Clock could follow later in kdeplasma-addons.
